text_block_list.text:
The 'first three years' with Vodka were
a massive success, leaving behind countless legends.

Vodka's legend of the impossible, the reckless, and the foolhardy.
Yet, it showed no signs of stopping...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I have a favor to ask.
It's a pretty unreasonable request, but...
choice_data_list: OK, I'm used to reckless stuff.
OK, I'm used to being reckless.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wait, before I even got to ask?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, thanks, partner. You catch on quick.
So, about the details..."

After consulting with Vodka, a rush construction project
began in a corner of Tracen Academy. And then—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, what is this~? This was an empty lot
until just last week, wasn't it? And yet...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: They set up a special course~?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oryaryaryaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* Trainer,
this course really is tough...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The turf catches your feet and just saps your stamina all at once.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Vodka? Trainer?
What are you two doing?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What is this place, anyway?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yo, Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey, do you know where we are?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh, you're asking where this is...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's on the outskirts of Tracen Academy, right?
Well, of course it is.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Tch, tch, tch...
That's where you're wrong.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This is—"Europe."
In other words, a European racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"After all, it was modeled after that place.
Not Tracen Academy."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: A European course...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right!
Looking closely, the type of turf is completely different.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Did someone plant these on purpose?
Whatever for?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Isn't it obvious? It's to prepare for our overseas expedition.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I gotta pay back the debt
from when I stumbled right after the Derby someday.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So you built a whole dedicated course
just for that!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Are you an idiot?!
Who in their right mind does that?!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Normally, no one would do that.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm gonna do it!
—Because I'm Vodka!
(Clang!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So, first we're going on an inspection.
The idiot duo, that is.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Idiot" was uncalled for.
Yeah, I'll make sure to watch closely.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The next pinnacle
that I must challenge.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Still, what are you going for?
Europe isn't suited for you at all, is it?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be fine to just keep winning domestically where your sharp turn of foot shines?
So why...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going precisely because it's not suited for me.
Just because everyone thinks I 'can't win.'"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I've certainly gotten stronger. Domestically, I might
even be in the top class. But...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"What's the point in only winning where you know you can win?
That's not a challenge anymore."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Once you get stronger, challenge someone even stronger!
Challenging others is the only way to truly live!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"And the only ones who are cool are those who keep challenging themselves.
Right, Trainer?"

Having run as she pleased and defied common sense,
Vodka has no hesitation.

"Fearless of anything, I will continue to
charge straight into the unknown walls ahead."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"All right, I'm off, Scarlet!
You'd better get stronger by the time I get back!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "While I'm checking out the sights, I'll blow the whole world away and come right back."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: See ya!

"Vodka became a famous Umamusume by doing things her own way. But
when people talk about her, no one ever just talks about her race record."

Everyone describes Vodka with just one phrase:
"The coolest horse girl there is."
